viewer: Retirees keeping their next 5 years of spending in CDs or Treasuries at a time when 1-year rates top 5-year rates.
decision: When a 1-year CD pays more than a 5-year CD, should I keep rolling the 1-year or lock the 5-year?
promise: We replay every past stretch when 1-year yields topped 5-year yields and follow both choices to the end of the 5 years.
title: 1-Year CD Pays More Than a 5-Year: Roll or Lock?
thumbnail: Short and long CD certificates on a tilting balance scale / "Roll or Lock?"
